rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Short Swann Road kerb with homes 6-9 m away and a kink in the line.
reasons: Detached homes 6 m and 9 m away
Only 32 m, on a busy road

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 6 m (at 17 m) and 9 m (at 32 m) from the south kerb; more homes 14-15 m; apartments 16 m opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the lane edge, but the south side is a narrow verge in front of houses.
drivers.traffic: Swann Road carries traffic both ways, with a junction just past the end.
drivers.convention: No signs. A few cars park on the north side but this south stretch is short and exposed.

sun_shade: Trees shade the south verge from the afternoon west; road is open to the north.
